title: D&A Pharma v European Medicines Agency (EMA), C-467/25 P
issuing_body: Court of Justice of the European Union, Eighth Chamber
holding_summary: The Court dismissed D&A Pharma's appeal in full after rejecting the grounds concerning interest in bringing proceedings and appellate review limits.
The judgment is procedural and does not determine the scientific efficacy or safety merits of the medicinal product or the underlying CHMP assessment.
